# Zerror Studios

> Zerror Studios is a design studio in Mumbai, India, started in February 2022. One team designs, builds and markets brands: custom websites with GSAP and scroll-led motion, online stores on Shopify and on Zcom (the studio's own commerce platform), custom software, and branding, social media and SEO. 100+ clients and 200+ websites and products.

Contact: admin@zerrorstudios.com

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.zerrorstudios.com/): the studio and selected brands
- [Work](https://www.zerrorstudios.com/work): every brand we can show, linking to the live sites
- [About](https://www.zerrorstudios.com/about): the story and the team
- [Websites](https://www.zerrorstudios.com/expertise/websites): custom websites designed and built by one team, with SEO and AI search built in
- [eCommerce](https://www.zerrorstudios.com/expertise/ecommerce): custom Shopify stores and Zcom
- [Software and tools](https://www.zerrorstudios.com/expertise/software-and-tools): custom CMS, dashboards and internal tools
- [Branding, marketing and SEO](https://www.zerrorstudios.com/expertise/branding-and-marketing): identity, social media, campaigns, SEO and AI search
- [Contact](https://www.zerrorstudios.com/contact): start a project
- [Pitch deck](https://www.zerrorstudios.com/pitchdeck)

RPSG Lifestyle Media (The Hollywood Reporter India, Esquire India, Robb Report India, Manifest), Salman Khan Films, Point Of, Studio Akto, Disrptve, Deveshe Dreams, Nahara, Crimzon.
